recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12684 unless a future work group decision reopens ContactPoint.system/use modeling; FHIR-16964 and the Zulip thread are background only.
issue_request: FHIR-12684 challenged overlap between ContactPoint.system and ContactPoint.use, suggesting mobile should move from use to system and phone might be renamed; it was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification and the final action was to add SMS as a ContactPoint.system code.
initial_application: The historical application is explicit: SVN-migrated git commit 989cec4f7a added the sms row to the contact-point-system worksheet for #12684, and git commit 677cd94f4f updated the ContactPoint.system element's code list/short name to include sms.
additional_context: ContactPoint is an active normative datatype published through the datatypes page. Current source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml lists ContactPoint.system as phone | fax | email | pager | url | sms | other, defines sms in the contact-point-system worksheet, and retains mobile in ContactPoint.use. Later FHIR-16964 was Resolved - No Change for a related request to make ContactPoint.system/use extensible or add other use values, and a 2019 Zulip implementers thread referencing GF#12684 did not record a final superseding change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already implements the final Jira decision and no current-build correction is needed.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change tracker on ContactPoint system/use extensibility supports leaving the current structural model unchanged.
